title: Frosty's Hot Dog
description: Frosty's Special Hot Dog finally comes to Minecraft!
body:
Frosty's **Hot Dog** comes to Minecraft.

Featuring:
- Custom Crafting Recipes
- Custom Hot Dogs
- **Delicious** Taste
- New Food that gives 1000 Hunger Points
- **Frosty approved** Custom Textures
- Multiplayer Compatability
